messages.text: BL-2060 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for QA's approval-tap hotfixes c416adc5fb and 4453766c28: the cursor bridge's start-time inbound-queue flag, baked to 0 during the 2026-10-06 swarm death, kept it polling getUpdates beside a live front desk for 14 hours, so every approval tap that reached it was answered and dropped; an auto-decided flag now yields to the per-poll feeder liveness, and a front-desk 409 retries within 5 s
